default.$description: The ordinary transition. Named `default` by the contract; `step` is the diagram vocabulary for the same value.

standard.$description: Default easing. The contract spells this group `easing`; `ease` is the diagram vocabulary for the same curve.

emphasized.$description: For motion that should feel decisive — an element entering from off-screen, a sheet arriving. Accelerates harder and settles later than `standard`. Not an alias: no existing curve carried this meaning.
